                                          BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2009-005
                                                           Technical


        Supersedes:           None

               Issuer:        James P. Colgate, RA, Esq.
                              Assistant Commissioner for Technical Affairs and Code Development

     Issuance Date:           April 3, 2009

            Purpose:          This document clarifies that only electric clothes dryers may be exempt from exhausting to
                              the outside of a building

      Related Code             MC    504.1
        Section(s):           FGC    614.1


          Subject(s):         Clothes dryer, exhaust


Both the 2008 NYC Mechanical Code ("MC") and 2008 NYC Fuel Gas Code ("FGC") establish venting
requirements for clothes dryers that are installed or replaced under the 2008 Construction Codes. In particular,
Section MC 504.1 requires clothes dryers to be exhausted but provides the following exception:

          “This section shall not apply to listed and labeled condensing (ductless) electric clothes dryers.”

Section FGC 614.1 requires the same and provides a similar, but not identical, exception:

          “This section shall not apply to listed and labeled condensing (ductless) clothes dryers.”

Although Section FGC 614.1 provides a general exception for listed and labeled condensing clothes dryers, the
exception in MC 504.1 is more specific.

Therefore, only electric clothes dryers that are listed and labeled may be exempt from exhausting to the outside of
a building. In all other cases, clothes dryers must exhaust to the outside of the building.
